summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc) per RBC-QM-02: 4 members, all aged 46-75 at end of 2026.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0005), message sent (comm-t0006) | Looked excluded at first (frailty plus donepezil), but Dr. Lin's message that arrived during the work says the Frailty entry belonged to another patient (cond-00189, now entered in error). No frailty means no exclusion. No nursing home, hospice or palliative care, and no colorectal cancer. No qualifying screening on record. Note written (doc-t0011). |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice care during 2026: finished hospice episode eoc-00002, 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-21, for pancreatic cancer. She revoked hospice for a clinical trial, but a finished episode still counts. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0001), message sent (comm-t0003) | Her only stool test (FIT obs-01732) was corrected: collected 2025-12-31, not 2026-01-05, so it is outside the 2026 period. No other screening. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0002), message sent (comm-t0004) | The 2024 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871) is entered in error; Harbor Lab says the specimen belonged to another patient. The 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) is only an order, not a completed test. No other screening. |

All FIT orders run 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. No patient had an active FIT order beforehand. Four new inbox items came in while I worked and are now closed with comments: inbox-a0001 changed pt-0009 from excluded to open gap; a0002, a0003 and a0004 left the existing decisions unchanged. No other new items.
